rationale: WRONG_PAPER_MISMATCH (paper_mention_mismatch; reason: "full text not accessible" for target record): The record metadata specifies Adam E. & Badu E. (2024), "Community-led total sanitation (CLTS) implementation in West Mamprusi Municipal Assembly in Ghana. What do communities think eleven years on?", DOI 10.1016/j.glohj.2024.05.003. However, the retrieved PDF full text is an entirely different article: Kouassi H.A.A. et al. (2023), "Factors influencing community-led total sanitation (CLTS) implementation abandonment before achieving open defecation-free (ODF) status: case study of the Central-Western region of Burkina Faso", Environmental Science and Pollution Research 30:125628-125645, DOI 10.1007/s11356-023-31142-y. Because no text of the target record is present and guessing from title/metadata alone is prohibited, the screening decision under both the narrow 2026-10-13 reading and plain wording of Criterion 2 is cannot_tell (exclusion_code: NONE).
